settings.heading: 1994
settings.text: Karen Feldman arrives in the Czech Republic to oversee production at a shampoo factory.

settings.heading: 1997
settings.text: Feldman begins her foray into the Czech glass market by launching her new firm, ARTĚL.

settings.heading: 1998
settings.text: ARTĚL’s first collection appears at the New York International Gift Fair.

settings.heading: 1998
settings.text: ARTĚL earns its first mention in The New York Times.

settings.heading: 1999
settings.text: The Financial Times recommends ARTĚL champagne flutes to usher in the new millennium.

settings.heading: 2000
settings.text: ARTĚL makes its first appearance at Paris’s exclusive interiors trade show, Maison & Objet.

settings.heading: 2001
settings.text: ARTĚL’s private showroom opens in Prague.

settings.heading: 2001
settings.text: ARTĚL glassware appears on the shelves of Harrod’s and Barney’s in Japan.

settings.heading: 2002
settings.text: World-renowned artist and designer Sol LeWitt commissions ARTĚL to manufacture a limited edition of 250 tumbler sets.

settings.heading: 2003
settings.text: Color makes its first appearance in ARTĚL products, with hand painting on selected motifs.

settings.heading: 2004
settings.text: Rolls-Royce commissions ARTĚL to manufacture a commemorative bowl for their 100th anniversary.

settings.heading: 2004
settings.text: ARTĚL motifs become available in colored glass.

settings.heading: 2004
settings.text: The Cooper Hewitt Museum exhibits ARTĚL’s collection of four tumblers by Sol LeWitt.

settings.heading: 2005
settings.text: Rolls-Royce introduces a custom-designed ARTĚL drink set as an option for inclusion in all models.

settings.heading: 2005
settings.text: “Woodland”, a large bowl featuring a hand-engraved forest motif, appears in a numbered edition of 250. It is the first limited-edition ARTĚL original.

settings.heading: 2006
settings.text: ARTĚL collaborates with David Wiseman, a rising star of the American design scene, to create the Glacier Collection.

settings.heading: 2006
settings.text: ARTĚL’s Glacier Vase, designed by David Wiseman, is featured at Cooper-Hewitt Museum’s National Design Triennial.

settings.heading: 2007
settings.text: Karen Feldman self-publishes "Prague: ARTĚL Style" to rave reviews.

settings.heading: 2007
settings.text: ARTĚL opens its flagship store in Prague’s Old Town.

settings.heading: 2008
settings.text: ARTĚL’s limited edition Czech Artists Collection wins top prize at Designblok.

settings.heading: 2008
settings.text: “Prague: ARTĚL Style” is named “Best Travel Guide” at the 12th annual Independent Publishers Awards.

settings.heading: 2009
settings.text: ARTĚL Design Shop is featured in the New York Times article: “36 Hours in Prague.”

settings.heading: 2009
settings.text: ARTĚL is honored at the Czech Grand Design Awards in two categories: Showroom of the Year and Manufacturer of the Year.

settings.heading: 2009
settings.text: Elie Wiesel presents, The Foundation Award (made by ARTĚL), to Natalie Portman at their Gala in 2009.

settings.heading: 2010
settings.text: ARTĚL is commissioned by Asprey to create a new crystal collection.

settings.heading: 2010
settings.text: ARTĚL opens a second retail store in Prague’s Mala Strana district.

settings.heading: 2011
settings.text: ARTĚL collaborates with Manolo Blahnik to create a special edition of glasses in honor of their 40th anniversary, to be sold exclusively by Lane Crawford.

settings.heading: 2011
settings.text: ARTĚL wins the Gift & Decorative Accessories Magazine Retailers Excellence Award for Best Store Design.

settings.heading: 2012
settings.text: ARTĚL’s Jungle Baroque set wins best collection award at Ambiente trade fair in Frankfurt.

settings.heading: 2012
settings.text: ARTĚL’s Glacier collection, designed by David Wiseman, is acquired by the Corning Museum of Glass for its permanent collection.

settings.heading: 2012
settings.text: Elie Wiesel presents, The Foundation Award (made by ARTĚL), to Tom Hanks at their Gala in October 2012.

settings.heading: 2013
settings.text: Giorgio Armani commissions ARTĚL to create an exclusive set of barware.

settings.heading: 2013
settings.text:
Karen Feldman self-publishes the 2nd Edition of
Prague: ARTĚL Style.

settings.heading: 2013
settings.text: Drinks Cabinet by Amy Somerville, won the new product prize for the show at DECORAX 2013, and she chose to merchandise it with ARTĚL’s Waterlilies collection.

settings.heading: 2014
settings.text: “Prague: ARTĚL Style” is named “Best Travel Guide” at the 18th Annual Independent Publishers Awards.

settings.heading: 2014
settings.text: ARTĚL opens a third retail store located in Prague’s historic Old Town – at Platnéřská 7 – near the iconic Charles Bridge and only steps away from the Four Seasons Hotel.

settings.heading: 2014
settings.text: George Clooney being presented the Arts for Humanity Award (which happens to be an ARTĚL Verdure bowl), by the Elie Wiesel Foundation for Humanity.

settings.heading: 2014
settings.text:
Zelouf + Bell, award winning furniture designers, collaborated with ARTĚL to make this fabulous SAKURA cabinet. ARTĚL produced the SAKURA glass panels.
Photo: Roland Paschhoff

settings.heading: 2014
settings.text: ARTĚL's Design Store is named one of the 6 of the most iconic stores in Prague by Condé Nast Traveler.

settings.heading: 2014
settings.text: Prague: ARTĚL Style named among 12 Indie Guidebooks You Should Never Travel Without by Yahoo! Travel.

settings.heading: 2015
settings.text: Karen Feldman has first radio interview with Radio Praha.

settings.heading: 2015
settings.text: Czech Grand Design nominates ARTĚL for RETAIL STORE OF THE YEAR 2015 for our SMĚR Toy Retrospective.

settings.heading: 2016
settings.text: A portfolio of ten fine art prints of beautiful mathematical expressions was created in 2014 by Parasol Press Ltd. In 2016 ARTĚL introduced a set of barware glasses based on these prints, in a limited edition of 100 sets.

settings.heading: 2017
settings.text: ARTĚL wins Travel and Hospitality Award for Excellence in Service 2018 – for Prague.

settings.heading: 2018
settings.text: ARTĚL celebrates 20th Year!

settings.heading: 2018
settings.text: ARTĚL wins Luxury Lifestyle Awards 2018 for Luxury Glass Manufacturer of the Year.

settings.heading: 2018
settings.text: ARTĚL's Jungle Deco - finalist for Tableware International Awards of Excellence in Artisanal category.

settings.heading: 2018
settings.text: ARTĚL's Barnyard Collection Wins Tableware International Award of Excellence in Fine Glassware category.

settings.heading: 2019
settings.text: ARTĚL’s Barnyard Collection – Wins German Design Award.

settings.heading: 2019
settings.text: ARTĚL’s Cabinet of Curiosities Gilded Collection - finalist for Tableware International Awards of Excellence in Artisanal category.

settings.heading: 2020
settings.text: ARTĚL’s African Safari Collection Wins Tableware International Award of Excellence in Fine Glassware category.

settings.heading: 2020
settings.text: ARTĚL’s Cabinet of Curiosities Gilded Collection – nominate for German Design Award.

settings.heading: 2021
settings.text: ARTĚL introduced two iconic new motifs – Dinosaur Collection II and Primeval Palms.

settings.heading: 2022
settings.text: ARTĚL introduced a strikingly bold new color – Metallic Titanium Green.

settings.heading: 2023
settings.text: ARTĚL celebrates 25 Years!

settings.heading: 2023
settings.text: ARTĚL introduced the Animation Collection, curated by the British novelist and futurist J. M. Ledgard, a set of six barware glasses in a limited edition of 100 sets. Designs by: Federico Díaz, Vojtěch Novotný, Mark Pauly, Kim Stanley Robinson, Nina Rodin and Tomás Saraceno

settings.heading: 2024
settings.text: ARTĚL collaborates with Amber Cowan, a celebrated American glass artist, to create the Flights of Fantasy Collection, based on Cowan’s sculptural works consisting entirely of vintage industrial pressed glass.
